seen.body: Owner (this session), about the two stuck divergences on qew's own ledger: 'actually qews should filter these divergences from its boards they should have a special label like qew:diverged and drop out of the project boards and be filtered out. when in managed mode they should also get qew:managed removed. yes they should also be closed.' Needs a short clarification before building: it overlaps with 5.5.0 auto-fix (divergences=ledger settles them on the same sync, so a label would only show in report mode or when the settle cannot push). Draft; asking the owner.
seen.title: Diverged issues leave the boards: a qew:diverged label, off the project board, qew:managed removed
